kind: other
depth: deep
reason: deep-dynamic-structure
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_demo_widget" "this" {
  dynamic "rule" {
    for_each = var.rules
    content {
      id = rule.key
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "p" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["demo:Get"]
    resources = [for r in aws_demo_widget.this.rule : r.id]
  }
}

variable "rules" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_demo_widget" "this" {
  dynamic "rule" {
    for_each = var.rules
    content {
      id = rule.value
    }
  }
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "p" {
  statement {
    actions   = ["demo:Get"]
    resources = [for r in aws_demo_widget.this.rule : r.id]
  }
}

variable "rules" {
  type = any
}
